parole.significato: A stuffed jacket worn under the mail, or (later) a jacket plated with mail.
parole.testo: From Middle English aketoun, aketon, from Old French aqueton, auqueton, alqueton, from Old Spanish alcoton (modern algodón), from Arabic الْقُطْن (al-quṭn), definite of قُطْن (quṭn, “cotton”). Doublet of cotton.

parole.significato: A domesticated dog of an extinct breed related to the modern bulldog and mastiff, or modern breeds created in imitation…
parole.testo: From Old French alans, alanz, itself from Old Spanish alán, itself possibly from Gothic *𐌰𐌻𐌰𐌽𐍃 (*alans), designating the Alan tribe of Eastern Iranian origin who were active in Western Europe during the Migration Period and were associated with the breed.
